''See also: [[Aurelian Empire Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The [[Aurelian]] Empire was a vast, unified global dominion characterized by its standardization of the [[Imperial language]] and its central Authority{{!}}authority under an Emperor. The empire's identity was represented by a golden shield crest featuring a sun and crescent moon, a symbol used on uniforms, carpets, and armor. Historically, the empire was founded by figures such as [[Alagaeus]] and Jorin Curse-breaker{{!}}Jorin, with the Emperor wielding immense power through a specialized [[throne]] known as the [[Optasia]]. This device allowed the ruler to connect to a global network of receptors, providing the ability to monitor and counter threats like the [[Great Elders]] from a distance. The empire's stability relied heavily on various [[Guilds]] and an [[Imperial Guard]] composed of alchemically enhanced individuals. Following the death of the Emperor, the empire entered a period of instability known as the [[Long Mourning]], marked by riots and fragmentation. While [[Regents]] attempted to maintain order, many believed the empire could not survive without a central Emperor to prevent it from splitting into separate kingdoms. This period of transition eventually led to the declaration of the end of the [[Aurelian]] Empire by the [[Regents]] and the emergence of the [[Aurelian Alliance]]. Despite this shift, some factions remained committed to the ideal of a single united empire, leading to the appointment of Imperial Steward Calder Marten{{!}}Calder Marten as the [[Imperial Steward]].}}
